summary: Keep one inventory per environment, such as inventory_test and inventory_staging, to avoid accidentally changing the wrong environment, and target with -i plus -l.
questions: How do I keep test and staging hosts from being mixed up?
Should I use separate inventory files per environment?
How do I run a playbook on only app servers in test?

answer_card.title: One inventory per environment
answer_card.answer_md:
Define each environment's hosts in its own file so you can't accidentally touch test when updating staging.

`inventory_test`:
```ini
[dbservers]
db01.test.example.com
[appservers]
app01.test.example.com
```
Run:
```bash
ansible-playbook -i inventory_test -l appservers site.yml
```
